archive.source: test-only Ubuntu native toolchain snapshot with absolute and dangling symlinks removed
archive.packagingCommand: mkdir -p staging; cp -a bazel-bin/native_toolchain.root/usr bazel-bin/native_toolchain.root/etc staging/; find staging -type l -lname '/*' -delete; find staging -type l -xtype l -delete; tar --sort=name --mtime=@0 --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner -C staging -cf - usr etc | gzip -n > native-aot-toolchain.tar.gz

remoteCache.server: bazel-remote v2.6.2 in a separate Apple Container
remoteCache.seed: fresh Bazel output base; HTTP remote cache; no disk cache
remoteCache.consumer: separate Apple Container, workspace and Bazel output base; no ambient clang or gcc; remote uploads disabled

limits: This archive is a broad qualification snapshot, not a minimal versioned native toolchain distribution.
The test proves HTTP cache recovery and local execution without ambient compilers; it does not test remote execution.
